verdicts.reason: A3 fails: the brief requires recording why each thread was opened and reading headers first, but the done-when only compares opened ids to rule-marked ids and checks neither a per-open reason in the log nor that the header scan came before the first open.

All rules hold: a verbatim ask-quote grep at a msg/line locator is program-readable, one named thread and match-the-ask are anchored, stop-before-send rests on the absent send/reply/forward tools, 'no draft: unsupported' is valid, status assisted matches the brief, and checkRunnable false is honest since no ask-match program exists.

All rules hold: a program computes strict-inequality overlaps from calendar times, names both events, excludes back-to-back, accepts 0/0, and treats no calendar times as unread; status is assisted and checkRunnable false is honest because no overlap program is written.

A3 fails: the brief requires one agenda item per source, but the done-when only greps each item's quote in its cited source and never checks that the sources are distinct, so two items from one source would still pass.

All rules hold: a jq -e schema check on a booking sheet with booked false covers 'prepare details', stop rests on absent create_event, Zapier write and submit tools, and status gated does not exceed the brief's 'Stop, always gated'.

All rules hold: a jq -e schema check on a payment sheet with paid false covers 'prepare details', stop rests on the registry's absent payment tool and the pay, payment and checkout deny verbs, and status gated matches the brief.
